question.text: As per the enumerated list in SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019 (Annex A) on the Stewardship Code applicable to AIFs and MFs, the Code is based on how many principles?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019 (Annex A) enumerates six principles - policy on stewardship responsibilities, conflict-of-interest management, monitoring of investee companies, intervention/collaboration policy, voting and voting-disclosure policy, and periodic reporting. The NISM Series XIX-B workbook reproduces this enumerated list as Principle 1 through Principle 6 on pp.54-55, confirming six. The Trap: Three, Four and Ten are simply distractor counts. The original audit flagged that the workbook narrative line on p.54 said the Code "is based on the following five principles" - an internal workbook typo that conflicts with its own enumerated list. By anchoring the stem to the SEBI Circular's Annex A enumerated list, that workbook narrative ambiguity is removed. Note: The original question was ambiguous because the same workbook page contained an internal conflict between a narrative "five principles" line and the enumerated six-principle list. The stem has been tightened to cite SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019 (Annex A) and the enumerated list explicitly, and the "Five" distractor has been replaced with "Four" to avoid leaning on the typo. Source: NISM Series XIX-B (AIF Cat III Distributors) pp.54-55 and SEBI Circular CIR/CFD/CMD1/168/2019.
